## 4. One important RV-specific warning

When you plug a portable station into the RV's shore-power inlet, the RV's converter may start charging the house battery from the power station. That can waste substantial energy or create an unexpectedly large load.

Make sure you understand your converter and charging setup. Disable unnecessary converter charging when appropriate, and don't allow an RV battery charging arrangement to create a charging loop. For a propane/electric absorption fridge, select propane mode rather than electric mode.
